Identified Issue: Vibration-related leak at compressor discharge piping
Required Corrective Action: Commission a vibration and pipe-support review of compressor discharge piping and implement the engineer's findings.
Verification Requirement: Written review report, close-out list signed by Asset Integrity Engineer, re-inspection of supports.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-001: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Gas detector calibration not tracked
Required Corrective Action: Create a detector register with calibration due dates and route detector fault alarms to the control room display.
Verification Requirement: Register audited against calibration certificates; alarm routing witnessed by HSE Manager.

Identified Issue: Safety trips or alarms inhibited without control
Required Corrective Action: Introduce an override and inhibit register and commission an independent review of compressor trip settings.
Verification Requirement: Register audit; review report; trip test records witnessed by a competent person.

Identified Issue: Pressure relief devices past test interval
Required Corrective Action: Build a relief-device register with due dates and schedule overdue devices for testing by a competent provider.
Verification Requirement: Register reviewed monthly; test certificates on file for 100% of devices.

Identified Issue: Oil leaks near hot surfaces in compressor area
Required Corrective Action: Fit shielding and drip containment at identified oil leak points and set a repair timeframe for new leaks.
Verification Requirement: Visual verification by HSE officer; weekly rounds record shows no open oil leaks beyond timeframe.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-005: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Abnormal suction conditions not recognised
Required Corrective Action: Install or verify inlet separator level alarms and issue a response guide for abnormal suction conditions.
Verification Requirement: Alarm test record; operator briefing sign-off; supplier review of response guide.

Identified Issue: Storage pressure equipment inspection dates not tracked
Required Corrective Action: Create a pressure equipment register with an inspection scheme set by a competent person and escalate overdue inspections.
Verification Requirement: Register audit; inspection reports filed; overdue list reviewed monthly by Operations Manager.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-007: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Vehicle impact on storage cascade or piping
Required Corrective Action: Install crash protection around storage assemblies and mark vehicle routes and speed limits.
Verification Requirement: Installation photographs and layout drawing; HSE walkthrough sign-off.

Identified Issue: Unauthorised access to storage area
Required Corrective Action: Repair perimeter and gate defects, introduce an entry log and add CCTV coverage of the storage area.
Verification Requirement: Perimeter inspection record; CCTV coverage check; entry log audit.

Identified Issue: Emergency isolation not remotely available
Required Corrective Action: Commission an engineering assessment for remotely operated isolation and an emergency shutdown station at storage.
Verification Requirement: Assessment report approved by Operations Manager; functional test record after any installation.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-010: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Ignition sources in hazardous areas not controlled
Required Corrective Action: Commission a hazardous area classification review and audit installed electrical equipment against it.
Verification Requirement: Classification drawings issued; equipment audit register; non-conformances raised as actions.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-011: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Transfer hose damage or overdue retirement
Required Corrective Action: Create a hose register, set retirement criteria with the supplier and fit restraints on transfer hoses.
Verification Requirement: Register audit; supplier test certificates; restraint installation check.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-012: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Coupling connection or disconnection error
Required Corrective Action: Evaluate and fit interlocked or keyed couplings with pressure indication and add second-person verification to the connection checklist.
Verification Requirement: Supplier specification; trial record; checklist audit of 20 transfers.

Identified Issue: Trailer not earthed or restrained during transfer
Required Corrective Action: Install an earthing proving interlock and fixed wheel stops at each loading position.
Verification Requirement: Installation checked by HSE; interlock functional test record.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-014: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Exclusion zone not enforced during transfer
Required Corrective Action: Install barriers and a transfer-in-progress beacon, and require supervisor permission for entry to the transfer zone.
Verification Requirement: Installation check; zone entry audit over 30 transfers.

Identified Issue: Communication failure during transfer
Required Corrective Action: Provide a local emergency stop and a second communication channel at each loading position.
Verification Requirement: Function tests logged; supervisor audit.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-016: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Single person connecting at customer site
Required Corrective Action: Introduce a two-person rule for connection and disconnection and agree attendance with customers.
Verification Requirement: Delivery audit sample; signed customer interface agreements.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-017: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Customer site not assessed before first delivery
Required Corrective Action: Introduce a customer site survey and approval step before first delivery, with annual review.
Verification Requirement: Survey forms on file for 100% of active sites; sample audit by HSE.

Identified Issue: Driver fatigue on long routes
Required Corrective Action: Implement driving-hour limits with telematics alerts and dispatch rules.
Verification Requirement: Weekly telematics report; audit of exceptions; driver feedback sample.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-019: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Vehicle defects not caught before departure
Required Corrective Action: Implement a defect close-out rule preventing dispatch with open critical defects and track overdue servicing.
Verification Requirement: Fleet defect report; maintenance schedule compliance review.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-020: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Poor journey planning and route risk
Required Corrective Action: Document approved routes with risk assessments and require dispatch confirmation of route conditions.
Verification Requirement: Route register; dispatch audit.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-021: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Road collision involving a laden tube trailer
Required Corrective Action: Fit speed limiters and collision-warning aids on prime movers and run a defensive driving programme.
Verification Requirement: Fitment audit; driver course records; telematics speed exception reports.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-022: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Pre-trip tube trailer inspection inconsistent
Required Corrective Action: Replace the paper checklist with a standard electronic pre-trip inspection with supervisor sign-off.
Verification Requirement: Submission audit for 30 trips; spot check of walk-around.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-023: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Delivery-site hazards on arrival
Required Corrective Action: Add site access criteria and a stop-work rule to the delivery procedure.
Verification Requirement: Procedure issued; delivery audit sample.

Identified Issue: Inadequate isolation before work on gas lines
Required Corrective Action: Introduce isolation certificates with independent verification before opening gas lines.
Verification Requirement: Certificate audit of 20 jobs; independent verification record.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-025: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Hot work without adequate gas testing or controls
Required Corrective Action: Introduce a hot work procedure requiring recorded gas tests and a named fire watch, and list jobs that must use cold methods.
Verification Requirement: Permit audit; spot check of gas test records.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-026: Change-management record and verified replacement of the previous method.

Identified Issue: Maintenance by unauthorised or unqualified staff
Required Corrective Action: Issue a task competency matrix and authorisation list for maintenance on gas equipment.
Verification Requirement: Matrix reviewed against training records.

Identified Issue: Contractor unfamiliar with site hazards
Required Corrective Action: Introduce contractor prequalification and a site-specific induction with sign-off.
Verification Requirement: Induction register audit; sample of contractor jobs.

Identified Issue: Undocumented work authorisation
Required Corrective Action: Require a written permit for all non-routine maintenance and a daily permit coordination meeting.
Verification Requirement: Permit register audit.

Identified Issue: Poor housekeeping in workshop and yard
Required Corrective Action: Set housekeeping standards with designated storage for oily rags and combustibles.
Verification Requirement: Monthly audit scores.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-030: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: PPE not matched to tasks
Required Corrective Action: Issue a PPE matrix by task and carry out monthly condition checks.
Verification Requirement: PPE check log; supervisor spot-check results.

Identified Issue: Slips, trips and falls on wet or oily surfaces and trailer steps
Required Corrective Action: Apply anti-slip surfacing to trailer steps and wet areas and repair worn steps.
Verification Requirement: Inspection after works; incident trend review.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-032: Close-out report and installation photographs; competent-person sign-off where applicable.

Identified Issue: Manual handling of hoses and fittings
Required Corrective Action: Refresh manual handling training and provide hose support aids.
Verification Requirement: Training records; observation.

Identified Issue: Inadequate safety training and refreshers
Required Corrective Action: Build a competence matrix with refresher intervals and link it to work authorisation.
Verification Requirement: Matrix review; training completion KPI.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-034: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Weak hazard and near-miss reporting culture
Required Corrective Action: Launch a simple reporting channel and publish monthly feedback on reported items.
Verification Requirement: Report counts and closure times reviewed monthly.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-035: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Delayed escalation of a suspected gas leak
Required Corrective Action: Issue a report-first rule with clear evacuation triggers and include it in drills.
Verification Requirement: Drill observation; briefing records.

Identified Issue: Muster and evacuation not reliably accounted
Required Corrective Action: Introduce a muster headcount system including visitors and contractors and test it in drills.
Verification Requirement: Timed drill record.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-037: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Emergency communication failure
Required Corrective Action: Add backup communication and check the contact list quarterly.
Verification Requirement: Call-out test record.

Identified Issue: Emergency drills not covering key scenarios
Required Corrective Action: Publish a scenario drill programme and run a tube trailer release exercise.
Verification Requirement: Drill report with actions.

Identified Issue: No liaison with external responders for road incidents
Required Corrective Action: Establish liaison with fire services on routes and provide emergency information cards to drivers.
Verification Requirement: Liaison record; card check.

Identified Issue: Hot work began before a gas-test result was recorded.
Required Corrective Action: Make a recorded gas test a hold point on the hot-work permit, with the permit issuer physically present.
Verification Requirement: Permit audit; supervisor observation of three hot-work starts.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-041: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Isolation valve found not fully closed during a zero-energy check.
Required Corrective Action: Add a documented second-person verification and lock-and-tag record to the isolation step of the permit.
Verification Requirement: Sample of ten permits audited for the second-person signature.

Identified Issue: Operator slipped on an oily bay surface.
Required Corrective Action: Degrease and apply a non-slip surface treatment to the bay, with a spill-clean-up standard.
Verification Requirement: Surface inspection after treatment; spill clean-up checked during rounds.

Identified Issue: Abraded transfer hose found at pre-use check.
Required Corrective Action: Introduce hose retirement tags with a fixed service life and a quarantine rack for suspect hoses.
Verification Requirement: Hose register reconciled with tags by HSE Manager; quarantine rack inspected.

Identified Issue: Trailer air-brake leak found at a roadside stop.
Required Corrective Action: Add braking-system checks and a recorded fault-reporting step to the pre-trip routine.
Verification Requirement: Pre-trip sheets sampled weekly for a month by Fleet Manager.

Identified Issue: Refresher training overdue for several operators.
Required Corrective Action: Build a training matrix with due dates by role and schedule overdue refreshers.
Verification Requirement: Matrix reconciled with attendance records by HSE Manager.

Identified Issue: Third-party vehicle entered the transfer exclusion area.
Required Corrective Action: Install fixed barriers and refresh floor and sign markings at the loading bay.
Verification Requirement: Photo and walk-through verification; barrier positions checked against the layout drawing.

Identified Issue: Delivery aborted: customer site access unsuitable for the trailer.
Required Corrective Action: Introduce a pre-delivery site survey template, completed before the first delivery to any customer.
Verification Requirement: Completed surveys sampled for all new customer sites in the quarter.
Evidence of Closure: [SIMULATED] EV-048: Issued procedure or register, training or briefing record, and audit sample.

Identified Issue: Reversing vehicle came close to the storage protection line.
Required Corrective Action: Install additional impact protection and a marked reversing route away from the storage area.
Verification Requirement: Inspection of installed protection against drawing; traffic route walk-through.

Identified Issue: Radio failure during a transfer.
Required Corrective Action: Provide a back-up communication method for each transfer point and test it at shift start.
Verification Requirement: Shift-start test log; witnessed test by Operations Manager.

Identified Issue: Contractor began a task before the permit was signed.
Required Corrective Action: Retrain permit issuers and contractor supervisors on the permit hold point; add a gate check that no work begins without a signed permit.
Verification Requirement: Training record; gate-check sample audit.

Identified Issue: Trailer earthing clamp not attached before transfer start.
Required Corrective Action: Add earthing verification to the transfer checklist and evaluate a transfer permissive that depends on earthing proof.
Verification Requirement: Checklist audit; engineering evaluation report reviewed by Asset Integrity Engineer.

Identified Issue: Gas odour reported late by an operator.
Required Corrective Action: Run a short scenario briefing and drill on immediate reporting of suspected gas leaks, with a reporting card at each station.
Verification Requirement: Drill record; random check that staff can state the reporting route.

Identified Issue: Alarm inhibit not restored at shift handover.
Required Corrective Action: Add active inhibits to the shift handover record and display inhibited alarms on the control screen.
Verification Requirement: Handover records audited; screen display witnessed.
